pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown to black patches exhibit highly irregular, stellate geometries with sharp pixel-level gradients. Edge boundaries are non-linear, characterized by frequent jagged protrusions and deep invaginations. Spatial area of patches is heterogeneous, with larger, more complex shapes on the mid-flank transitioning to smaller, more fragmented regions on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored negative space forms a continuous branching network. Junction nodes are primarily trivalent or tetravalent. Pixel thickness of the pathways varies significantly, narrowing at the 'necks' of patch protrusions and widening at major intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background. The contour is composed of short, vertical pixel clusters of uniform height.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced 'oak-leaf' pattern morphology where the light corridor network penetrates deeply into the center of the dark patch masses, creating a highly fractured visual texture.
